_note: SpeedKills' decay and endgame (src/game/decay.ts, docs/PHASE_18_PLAN_SPEEDKILLS.md 7.10). finalCentre is the odds the match ends in the centre, the Spire (the owner: the biggest, hottest sector, where landing means less early running); otherwise one of the eight. perWave sectors go in each wave, furthest from the final sector first, with jitter metres of randomness in the order so two matches with the same final sector differ. A decaying sector dissolves bottom up over its close, so the ground floors go first and a player high in a tower has longer to get out, as the owner's brief pictured it.
_headroom: How far over a sector's highest box (the bake's collision, src/game/world.ts holdForDecay, decay.ts dissolveTop) its dissolve climbs by the end of its close: a body standing on the highest spot (movement.json standHeight, 1.83 m) and the line's jag (up to 1.4 m, world.ts teachDecay) both under the line. Measured per sector off the map in play, so each line spends its whole close on its own floors: a fixed 80 m had a corner block's 18 m done in 5 s of its 20, and never reached the tower's top (its roofs at 132 m, its mast's box at 144 m) before the sector was gone.
_grace: The quiet minute (the owner, 2026-10-11: "don't have any decay until a 1 min into the game ... if people want to loot for a couple mins then that's their choice and should be able to without fearing the zonepull"): grace seconds from the ring's start (the dropship gone) before wave 1's warning, with no sector flagged, beamed or hurting through it. It sits ahead of wave 1's wait and is not scaled by the lobby's pace, so the fast clock keeps the whole minute too.
_phases: The waves as the ring's rounds (ring.ts): wait is the warning, close the decay, damage what a tick does to anyone standing in a decaying or decayed sector. Four waves take eight sectors; the fifth round is the endgame, the capture zone's, whose wait is its length before the ring stops. Wave 1 is warned 50 s, after the quiet minute; the later waves 45 s, which keeps the match near its length with the minute added: a dropship of about 40 s, the grace's 60 s, wave 1's 70 s, three waves of 65 s and a capture held 45 s make 6.8 minutes, inside the owner's 6 to 7. The first sector dissolves about 2.5 minutes in.
_capture: The capture zone in the final sector, once every other sector is gone: a circle of radius metres at the sector's middle. A squad alone in it fills its meter; hold seconds of it wins the match outright (Hyper Scape's crown was held 45 s, in Ubisoft's own words at launch; the owner chose a zone for it). Two squads in it at once and neither fills.
